enrichment.summary: A contractor from Rohnert Park, CA will provide project management and coordination for the district's Expanded Learning Opportunities Program grant, through the Community Schools and Student Services Department. enrichment.summary: 510 MEDIA of Oakland, CA will develop "Choose OUSD" branding materials to be displayed around the city, online and in school communities, for the Student Assignment Department. enrichment.headline: Allows a researcher to use student data, at no cost, to build a de-identified data set
enrichment.summary: Under a no-cost services agreement and a data sharing agreement, a Berkeley, CA researcher will match school application data with enrollment data for the 2018-19 and 2019-20 school years. The researcher will have access to identifiable student data to prepare a de-identified data set to share with the California Policy Lab. Both run April 1 through December 31, 2022, and the board is approving them after the start date.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: Stericycle, Inc. of Lake Forest, IL will dispose of biohazardous regulated medical waste from Covid-19 testing at the school sites and pickup frequency listed in the agreement.
